*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&  Include           SZN_COMMON_FORMS

FORM ask_for_delete_object
     USING    p_object TYPE tnro-object
     CHANGING p_answer TYPE c.

 DATA: l_parameter    TYPE TABLE OF spar,
       l_parameter_wa TYPE spar.

  l_parameter_wa-param = 'par1'.
  l_parameter_wa-value = p_object.
  APPEND l_parameter_wa TO l_parameter.

  CALL FUNCTION 'POPUP_TO_CONFIRM'
       EXPORTING
         titlebar       = 'Löschen'(100)
         text_question  =
         'Wollen Sie das Nummernkreisobjekt &par1& löschen?'(101)
       IMPORTING
         answer         = p_answer
       TABLES
         parameter      = l_parameter
       EXCEPTIONS
         text_not_found = 1
         OTHERS         = 2.
  IF sy-subrc <> 0.
    MESSAGE ID     sy-msgid
            TYPE   sy-msgty
            NUMBER sy-msgno
            WITH   sy-msgv1 sy-msgv2 sy-msgv3 sy-msgv4.
  ENDIF.
  CASE p_answer.
    WHEN 'N'.
      MESSAGE s886 WITH p_object.
      p_answer = no.
    WHEN 'A'.
      MESSAGE s887 WITH p_object.
      p_answer = no.
    WHEN 'J'.
      p_answer = yes.
  ENDCASE.
ENDFORM.

FORM check_authority
     USING    p_object     TYPE tnro-object
     CHANGING p_auth       TYPE c.

* es werden die folgenden Rechte ermittelt:
* AUTH = 'N'  kein Recht
* AUTH = 'U'  Pflege
* AUTH = 'L'  Stand ändern
* AUTH = 'D'  Anzeige
  p_auth = 'N'.
  AUTHORITY-CHECK OBJECT 'S_NUMBER'
                      ID 'NROBJ' FIELD p_object
                      ID 'ACTVT' FIELD '*'.
  if sy-subrc = 0.
     p_auth = 'A'.
  else.
    AUTHORITY-CHECK OBJECT 'S_NUMBER'
                        ID 'NROBJ' FIELD p_object
                        ID 'ACTVT' FIELD '02'.
    if sy-subrc = 0.
      p_auth = 'U'.
    else.
      AUTHORITY-CHECK OBJECT 'S_NUMBER'
                      ID 'NROBJ' FIELD p_object
                      ID 'ACTVT' FIELD '11'.
      if sy-subrc = 0.
        p_auth = 'L'.
      else.
        AUTHORITY-CHECK OBJECT 'S_NUMBER'
                      ID 'NROBJ' FIELD p_object
                      ID 'ACTVT' FIELD '03'.
        if sy-subrc = 0.
          p_auth = 'D'.
        endif.
      endif.
    endif.
  endif.
ENDFORM.                    " authority_check
